messages.content: 你可以幫我訂一張泰勒絲在紐約的演唱會門票，加上VIP座位，然後再訂一張紅髮艾德在洛杉磯的演唱會門票，加上後台通行證和停車證，最後再訂一張科切拉音樂節在印第奧的門票，加上露營通行證和停車證嗎？

function.name: concert_book_ticket
function.description: Book a ticket for a concert at a specific location with various add-ons like backstage pass. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist.description: Name of the artist for the concert.

location.description: City where the concert will take place.

add_ons.description: Add-ons for the concert. Default is 'VIP Seating' if not specified.

function.name: festival_book_ticket
function.description: Book a ticket for a festival at a specific location with various add-ons like camping access. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: City where the festival will take place.

add_ons.description: Add-ons for the festival. Default is 'Camping Pass' if not specified.

message.reasoning:

2) Red-haired Eddie? Actually they say "红发艾德"? Might refer to "Red Hair Ed". But likely it's an event name or performer. The request says "加上后台通行证和停车证", i.e., backstage pass and parking pass. Location Los Angeles.

We need to interpret "red hair ed" as maybe "Ed Sheeran"? Not sure. Could also be "Eddie Redhair"? Let's assume it's "Red Hair Ed".

But we can treat it generically: Artist: "Red Hair Ed"

Location: Los Angeles

Add ons: Backstage Pass + Parking Pass

3) Coachella music festival in Indio. Add Camping Pass & Parking Pass.

So we have two concerts and one festival booking.

We'll call the appropriate tool twice: first for each concert using `concert_book_ticket`, second for festival using `festival_book_ticket`.

Need to provide arguments accordingly.

Concert #1: artist="Taylor Swift", location="New York", add_ons=["VIP Seating"]

Concert #2: artist="Red Hair Ed", location="Los Angeles", add_ons=["Backstage Pass","Parking Pass"].

Festival #3: festival="Coachella Music Festival", location="Indio", add_ons=["Camping Pass","Parking Pass"].

Let's produce calls sequentially.

Also note default add_on values exist but we override them.
